title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
lede: TechCrunch's running timeline traces how reports of Jensen Huang's ties to an alleged Chinese spy, and of affairs with Nvidia staff, led to his resignation within weeks.

points: U.S. officials believe Megaspeed executive Alice Huang spied for Beijing; Megaspeed reportedly bought $4.8 billion of Nvidia chips.
The New York Times reported the relationship on October 29, and Huang admitted infidelity to staff on November 8.
Further reports of affairs with Nvidia employees followed, and the board accepted his resignation on November 12.
Colette Kress became interim CEO and Harvey C. Jones the board's first chair; Huang agreed to testify to Congress before Thanksgiving.
Democrats are investigating how the administration handled Nvidia chip sales to China.

sections.text: Nvidia makes the chips most AI work runs on, and the scandal ties its leadership to the export controls that decide who can buy advanced GPUs.
